en.hubeali:
And by this chain, 
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘
Every man who is managed by a woman, so he is an accursed’.
en.sarwar: 10. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated: “’Amir al-Mu’minin ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A man who follows (unlawful) policies of woman is condemned.’”
